_comment: GEX offtake/contract engine (module 2) inputs. Edit values, not code.
_perspective_note: 'project' = value to the seller/producer. Floor is long-put (good), ceiling is short-call (bad), buyer volume flex is a cost (subtracted).

discounting._note: df(t) = exp(-r t). Used for all contract cashflows.

tenor._note: annual delivery dates (years from valuation). Periods are valued at year-end forwards/paths.

indexation._formula: P_index(S_t) = base + spread + beta * S_t   (S_t = modelled green-fuel price). Linear pass-through; this is the floating leg the options sit on.
indexation._note: beta<1 dampens index pass-through; spread is a fixed adder in $/MT. Set beta=1, spread=0, base=0 for a pure index-linked price.

collar._note: P_paid = min(max(P_index, floor), ceiling). floor protects the project (long put); ceiling caps it (short call). Priced by Monte Carlo on Q-paths, floor and ceiling reported separately.

volume._unit: kT/year (10^3 MT). baseline = nominated take with no flex. min/max = per-period nomination band (swing). total_min = take-or-pay floor over the life; total_max = max cumulative offtake.
volume._note: Volume flex is the buyer's swing option, valued by LSMC on Q-paths. take_levels discretises the per-period control; volume_grid_points discretises the cumulative-take state.

greenmesh_rollup._note: Plant/enterprise value = sum of contract values + merchant tail. Merchant tail = uncontracted capacity (capacity - baseline take) valued at the Q-forward * merchant_margin, discounted. An investor/offtaker can value the asset as the strip of its contracts plus the merchant residual.

simulation._note: Q-measure paths for collar + LSMC. Reuses module 1's simulate_paths(measure='Q'). Deterministic for audit.
